result.instructions: Tools for Ellibo Rental, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which rental items do we have, and how many units do we own of each?"; "Show me the rental orders that are late and their return times."; "Get the lines and status of order 1042.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ellibo Rental data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ellibo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ellibo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ellibo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ellibo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ellibo_list_places
tools.title: List pickup and return places
tools.description: List the pickup and return places of the rental business. Use it to find where items are collected or returned. Ellibo API: GET /v1/places.

tools.name: ellibo_list_items
tools.title: List rental items
tools.description: List rental items with their prices and how many units the business owns. Use it to check what can be rented. Ellibo API: GET /v1/items.

tools.name: ellibo_get_item
tools.title: Get a rental item
tools.description: Get one rental item with its prices and unit count. Ellibo API: GET /v1/items/{id}.

item_id.description: Numeric or string id from the list call.

tools.name: ellibo_list_orders
tools.title: List rental orders
tools.description: List rental orders (quotes, reserved orders, picked up, returned, late and cancelled) with their lines. Ellibo API: GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: ellibo_get_order
tools.title: Get a rental order
tools.description: Get one rental order with its lines and status. Ellibo API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

order_id.description: Numeric or string id from the list call.

tools.name: ellibo_list_order_invoices
tools.title: List invoices of a rental order
tools.description: List the invoices of one rental order. Ellibo API: GET /v1/orders/{id}/invoices.

order_id.description: Numeric or string id from the list call.
